aiTitle: Fix the flaky cart total test (SHOP-198)

message.content: cart.spec.ts fails about one run in ten on CI with 'expected 42.50, received 40.00'. SHOP-198. Can you find the race?

content.text: The test adds two items without awaiting the first addItem call, so the discount rule sometimes runs before the second item lands. Awaiting both calls makes it deterministic; I ran it 200 times locally with no failure.

message.content: Is the production code doing the same thing anywhere?

content.text: Yes, the quick-add button in CartDrawer.tsx fires addItem twice without awaiting. Fixed it there too and added a test that clicks it twice in a row.
